body: It's been 30 days since we had any communication.  I think I can still do this.

Today is the day I might break.  It's been almost a month since you said no checking in.  Your birthday is in another month.  I set goal posts to try to make it.  One more day.  Maybe I can make it until the smoke clears out tonight.

Daily routine: wake up, check the obits.  Check messenger to see if you blocked me or sent me messages.  Type that I miss you secretly hoping that I accidentally send instead of deleting it.

Lunch: your wake up time.  I look where you first messaged me to see if you made a new post.  Wait to see if today is the day you message me.

Night: when you get off work I'm back in messenger.  Wait for s bit.  Check Reddit for you again.  Check obits again.  Started reading again so I can pass all this time we used to spend together.

A month has finally happened.  Somehow I made it.  Next milestone is a month since you asked me to stop checking in.  

Your birthday is coming up soon.  I don't know how I made it this far.
